title: Update on Work Done as a Result of Shutting of Train Lines for Scheduled Maintenance
what_it_is: Update on Work Done as a Result of Shutting of Train Lines for Scheduled Maintenance

sections.label: Extended engineering hours for MRT works
sections.summary: Extended engineering hours in December 2017 and January 2018 gave 40 nights of extra time for East-West Line signalling testing and installation, and boosted maintenance, noise barrier and power supply works.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: During December 2017 and January 2018, extended engineering hours have provided the equivalent of 40 nights of additional time for the testing and installation of the East-West Line's new signalling system.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: This would otherwise have taken another one and a half months to achieve.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Barring any unforeseen developments, we are on track to complete the re-signalling programme by this June.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Singapore Mass Rapid Transit was also able to step up its maintenance regime, achieving two and a half times the usual volume of maintenance work each weekend along the closed stretches.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We have also taken the opportunity to advance noise barrier installation works at roughly one and a half times the usual pace, with the team completing the equivalent of three to four nights of work each weekend.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We are studying how similar additional engineering hours could also help us speed up the renewal of other operating assets on the North-South and East-West Lines, such as the upcoming replacement and upgrading of the power supply system.

sections.label: Continuing regime and commuter announcements
sections.summary: The regime will continue for the foreseeable future to expedite upgrading works, with early announcements of early closures or full closures so commuters can plan alternate transport.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: Yes, we will continue with this regime for the foreseeable future to expedite the upgrading and improvement works.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: At the same time, we will minimise inconveniences to commuters by early announcements of the scheduling of either early closures of the line or the entire closure of stretches, so that commuters can make alternate transportation planning.
